parts.text: 5 This question is about the homologous series of alkanes. Three general characteristics of alkanes are: • they are generally unreactive because they do not have a functional group • they show trends in their physical properties, such as melting points and boiling points • they have similar chemical properties.

ms.label: 5(a)
ms.text:
M1 (have a) general formula of CnH2n+2
M2 differ from one member to the next by a –CH2– unit

ms.label: 5(b)(ii)
ms.text:
M1 physical property
M2 change as chain length increases

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Propane has the structural formula CH 3 CH 2 CH 3 . When propane undergoes a monosubstitution reaction with chlorine at room temperature, two organic products can be formed.

ms.label: 5(d)(ii)
ms.text:
M1 CH3CH2CH2Cl
M3 1-chloropropane
M2 CH3CHClCH3
M4 2-chloropropane

ms.label: 5(d)(iii)
ms.text: (compounds with) the same molecular formula but different structural formulae or structure
